official_name.value: Nagoya University of Commerce and Business (NUCB)

eligible_auc_schools.notes: Excel agreement scope states 'Business Administration' major/field rather than an AUC school code.

min_gpa_host.notes: No minimum host GPA is stated in NUCB Fact Sheet 2020/21 or on nucba.ac.jp (JASSO scholarship applicants separately require 2.30/3.0 JASSO scale).

instruction_languages.notes: UG Global BBA and GR MBA/MSc international modules taught in English.

english_course_availability.notes: Full English-taught Global BBA (undergraduate) and graduate business exchange curricula.

english_proficiency_and_rhet1020.value: TOEFL iBT 80 / PBT 550, TOEIC 750, or IELTS 6.0 (min 5.5 in all 4 components). Students whose home courses are taught in English are exempted from test scores and instead submit a letter of recommendation from their academic advisor (RHET 1020 not explicitly cited; AUC instruction is in English).
english_proficiency_and_rhet1020.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Nagoya University of Commerce and Business (NUCB)/Nagoya University of Commerce and Business (NUCB).docx

host_language_requirement.value: No Japanese proficiency required for English-taught Global BBA/MBA exchange tracks.
host_language_requirement.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Nagoya University of Commerce and Business (NUCB)/Nagoya University of Commerce and Business (NUCB).docx

fall_term_dates.value: Fall Semester: Early September - Mid-January (Terms 3 & 4; dorm check-in early September; 2020/21 sheet noted Sept-Dec).
fall_term_dates.notes: 2020/21 summary in data/raw/factsheets/Nagoya University of Commerce and Business (NUCB)/Nagoya University of Commerce and Business (NUCB).docx.

spring_term_dates.value: Spring Semester: Early April - Late July (Terms 1 & 2; dorm check-in late March; note partner Excel currently lists Fall term only for AUC agreement).

tuition_model.notes: Bilateral partner exchange students are exempt from paying tuition fees to NUCB.

est_monthly_living_local.notes: Official NUCB Living Expense FAQ estimates JPY 60,000-90,000/month EXCLUDING accommodation (Greater Nagoya ~30% cheaper than Tokyo). Earlier 2020/21 Fact Sheet quoted JPY 120,000/month excl. accommodation plus dorm rent JPY 42,750-74,000/month.

living_cost_usd_est.notes: Midpoint JPY 75,000/month (60,000-90,000 JPY/month excluding accommodation) * 5 months = JPY 375,000; converted at ECB 2026-11-13 rate (collected 2026-11-15) 1 EUR = 176.83 JPY & 1 EUR = 1.1052 USD -> 1 JPY = 0.00625007 USD (https://www.ecb.europa.eu/stats/policy_and_exchange_rates/euro_reference_exchange_rates/html/index.en.html) = 2,343.78 USD (excludes dorm rent JPY 42,750-74,000/mo).

mandatory_host_fees_and_insurance.value: Tuition waived under bilateral exchange. All students in Japan are legally required to join Japan National Health Insurance (NHI, avg ~JPY 2,000/month, covering 70% of medical care). Casebooks/materials (~JPY 2,000/course) and residence check-in/deposit fees apply (2020/21 sheet: JPY 30,000 refundable deposit + JPY 22,500 check-in fee/sem).
mandatory_host_fees_and_insurance.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Nagoya University of Commerce and Business (NUCB)/Nagoya University of Commerce and Business (NUCB).docx

housing_availability.notes: Multiple NUCB residence halls allocated upon application (Meito, Chiyoda, Higashiyama Annex, Sanbongi, Sanbongi Campus / Hiroshi Hall / Koryo Hall); strict rules prohibit partying, gathering, and smoking.

housing_notes.value: Multiple NUCB halls in Nagoya & Nisshin (2020/21 rates incl. utilities: Sanbongi JPY 42,750/mo, Sanbongi Campus JPY 45,750/mo, Higashiyama Annex JPY 63,750/mo, Meito/Chiyoda JPY 74,000/mo; plus JPY 30,000 refundable deposit & JPY 22,500 non-refundable check-in fee per semester; newer halls include Hiroshi Hall & Koryo Hall).
housing_notes.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Nagoya University of Commerce and Business (NUCB)/Nagoya University of Commerce and Business (NUCB).docx

host_grants_or_stipends.value: NUCB Housing Scholarship / residence rent reductions automatically evaluated from transcripts/GPA; eligible nominees may also be nominated for the JASSO Short-Term Study in Japan Scholarship (subject to annual slot allocation).

visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.value: Students cannot enroll on a tourist visa. After registered-mail/portal hard-copy submission, NUCB applies to Japanese Immigration for a Certificate of Eligibility (COE), forwards COE + Acceptance Letter to home university, and student applies for a Student Visa at a Japanese Embassy/Consulate.
visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Nagoya University of Commerce and Business (NUCB)/Nagoya University of Commerce and Business (NUCB).docx

english_course_list_url.notes: Global BBA English-taught syllabus portal; graduate courses offered via NUCB Business School.

credit_system_and_load.value: 1 NUCB course = 2 NUCB credits (~3 ECTS, 14 sessions x 100 min + exam). Exchange load: minimum 12 NUCB credits (6 courses / 18 ECTS) and maximum 20 NUCB credits (10 courses / 30 ECTS) per semester.

course_restrictions_note.value: Business Administration / Management courses only per AUC agreement scope; strict residence conduct rules prohibit partying, gathering, and smoking.
course_restrictions_note.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Nagoya University of Commerce and Business (NUCB)/Nagoya University of Commerce and Business (NUCB).docx

value: Hard copies of completed application documents sent by registered mail (for COE filing)
TOEFL/IELTS/TOEIC scores OR academic advisor recommendation letter confirming English-medium instruction
required_application_docs.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Nagoya University of Commerce and Business (NUCB)/Nagoya University of Commerce and Business (NUCB).docx

academic_style.value: Interactive case-method business education (two mini-terms per semester: Terms 1-2 Spring, Terms 3-4 Fall) across Nisshin UG and central Nagoya campuses.

campus_type.notes: Nisshin Campus (green area east of Nagoya for UG Global BBA) and Nagoya Campus (central Nishiki, Naka-ku, Nagoya).

international_support_services.value: NUCB Center for International Affairs handles COE immigration filing, dorm placement across 5+ NUCB residences, and NUCB Housing Scholarship / JASSO nominations.
international_support_services.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Nagoya University of Commerce and Business (NUCB)/Nagoya University of Commerce and Business (NUCB).docx

nomination_deadlines.notes: Exact annual deadlines coordinated directly with partner offices (not published statically on NUCB's public page or in 2020/21 Fact Sheet).
